shared_elements: dense field of carved signs/symbols on an upright stone monument
script-like characters arranged in linear sequence (glyph blocks / runic band)
framed or bordered panels dividing the surface
justification: Both surfaces are upright monuments bearing rows of script-like signs within framing borders, but that is a generic correspondence: A is entirely a grid of rounded, cartouche-like glyph blocks with faces and no narrative scene, while B shows a figural picture (horse, human figures, ship-like or interlaced serpentine knotwork) with the writing confined to a narrow marginal band. The forms, relationships and drawing conventions — plump, curvilinear glyph cartouches versus linear outline figures and ribbon interlace — share nothing specific.
